open_points.subject: rules.http_router_backend route catalog
open_points.text: State 4 says “the route table keeps 50 of the 56 routes of `rules.http_router_backend`,” while State 2 still carries “`rules.http_router_backend` (56 routes …)” as the backend used by later closures.
open_points.question: Does the current `rules.http_router_backend` contain 50 routes with the six staff-challenge routes removed, or does it still contain 56 routes?
options: Replace the backend catalog with the 50 remaining routes
Keep a 56-route backend catalog while omitting or disabling the six challenge routes elsewhere
open_points.default_guess: Treat the owner’s 2026-11-07 removal as replacing the backend catalog with exactly 50 routes.

witness.initial: Later-state authors receive these texts and must materialize the HTTP router from `rules.http_router_backend`.
events: One implementer follows State 4 and generates only the 50 remaining routes.
Another implementer follows State 2’s carried backend and generates all 56 routes, including the six former challenge routes.
outcomes: Requests to a former email-verification, email-change, or password-reset route have no matching route.
The same requests reach a route, even if its handler rejects them or remains inert.
